title: Limit repeated password-reset requests
brief: Add one testable behavior to the existing API without changing its public response format.

workflow.name: TDD
constraints: Write and observe the failing test before adding production behavior.
Refactor only while the relevant tests remain green.

blocks.text: Limit repeated reset requests per account. Reuse the existing API and test runner. The exact allowance and time window must be agreed before implementation.

sections.title: Implement one behavior at a time

items.label: Failing test
items.detail: Write a test that exceeds the agreed allowance and confirm it fails for the missing behavior.

items.label: Minimum implementation
items.detail: Add the smallest change that rejects requests over the allowance.

items.label: Verify
items.detail: Run the focused tests and the related reset-flow checks.

items.label: Refactor
items.detail: Remove duplication while keeping the tests passing.

items.label: Requests at the limit remain allowed.
Requests above the limit are rejected.
A new time window restores the allowance.
One account does not consume another account’s allowance.

blocks.text: Inspect the project scripts to record the exact test command and affected files. Do not assume a framework or invent a passing result.
